title: 第18章 落霞圣地第19章 五行珠
slug: 混沌神体之鸿蒙至尊未命名95
content_zh:
叶辰一路上杀了近千头妖兽，一路尸体，叶辰一路疾行，来到一座山峰，便失去了意识，倒地不起。
落霞山脉此时到处都是战场，涌入了大量的修士，妖兽受了惊吓，到处都是妖兽，一部分都快跑到了落霞郡，好在之前钱郡守已有警觉，并未慌乱，只是四大家族此时全都进入了落霞山脉，守城的只有城主府的护卫和城卫军。城门已经关闭。
值得庆幸的是，妖兽并没有一开始计划袭城，如果不是天地异象，及时出现，晚发生几日，妖兽肯定会袭城的。眼下袭城的妖兽只有三万多，其余的妖兽散落在落霞山脉各处。
经过了一天一夜的杀伐，加上异象的消失，妖兽渐渐的回到了深处，山脉外围妖兽尸体随处可见。
城门口击杀的妖兽有两万之多，剩下的已经四散奔逃了
不过，此时的落霞山脉却迎来了大量的修士，四大宗门，皇城，各地大大小小的家族，竟有10万多修士.大多数淬体境修士只是在外围捡一些妖兽尸体去售卖，炼气境，大概有七八万人，筑基境有三四万人，金丹境大概有几百人吧！
常言道，人多是非多
“铿铿锵锵，乒乒乓乓”到处都是打斗声。
此时的叶辰，悠悠的睁开眼睛。看见一个紫衣少女，蛾眉敛黛，目光炯炯，晶莹澄澈，容颜娇嫩。正在看着自己。
“你醒了”少女平淡无奇的问道。声音柔和温婉，如天籁之音，空气中弥漫着淡淡的清幽淡雅的香气。
“你是”叶辰气若游丝，轻轻的询问
“我是青云宗，公冶倩儿，路过此处，隐约间感觉到你还有生气，便救了你”少女依然平淡无奇，古井无波，好似微不足道
“多谢公冶姑娘相救，他日姑娘若有需要，叶辰定当竭尽所能帮助姑娘”。叶辰坚定的回道，这可是仙帝一诺，万金难求啊！只是公冶倩儿此时还不知道今日的相救，却改变了她一生，两人日后曲曲折折，受尽了苦难
公冶倩儿没有表态，只是稍稍看了一眼，就不再理会。
叶辰看着冷艳的公冶倩儿，也不再说话，盘坐宁心，轻静自然，运转九转仙诀，其实，叶辰现在身体已无大碍，昏迷期间，公冶倩儿给叶辰问了一颗精元丹，乃是三品的疗伤丹药，加上叶辰的混沌体，本身就有自愈能力，加上混沌体无时不刻的吸收天地灵气，此次受伤，加上身体极限的杀伐，这次的疗伤彻彻底底从内到外，再次淬炼了身体，叶辰的体质现在已经堪比筑基境了。
叶辰安心修炼了三个时辰，身体痊愈了。
“你已痊愈，我们就此别过”公冶倩儿冷静的看着叶辰，转身就离开了
叶辰望着这个紫衣少女，暗暗的记在心里。换了一身衣服，走出了山洞。
一楼上到处都是打斗，修仙界人命如草芥，这就是一条不归路，没有成长起来的天才就不是天才，不是叶辰的冷漠，一路上叶辰放开神识极速赶路，不在关心这些打斗。
当感到结界之处，灵气浓度竟然是外边的10倍，周围的花草树木更加的生机勃勃，大量的修士冲进了结界内，叶辰也不再迟疑，迅速的跟了进去，这是一处遗址，入眼可见的断壁残垣，叶辰足足耽误了两天时间，附近几乎能带走的都带走了，叶辰仔细观察着周围，这是一个宗门的山门，一个巨大的匾额上写着落霞圣地的牌匾静静地躺在废墟之中，这牌匾竟然是地器，重达百万斤，一座山门竟有千丈之大，落霞圣地一望无际，到处都能看到白骨，和新的尸体，估计是争抢宝物所造成的

这场景如蝗虫过境一般，上千里了就没有找到一件有价值的东西。再往前走就看见一座广场，方圆足足有万里，足以容纳10万人，应该是演武场了，此处白骨铺满了地面，更有很多高大异常的骨骼，漆黑如墨。奇形怪状的，这好像是异族，广场周围全是山峰，此起彼伏，足足有上万座高峰。
继续深入吧，外围估计都是外门弟子的场所，价值肯定不高，这时混沌珠有了异动，叶辰发现小墨现在已经有一尺大了，随即把小墨移出了体外，小墨出来后，异常的兴奋，上蹦下跳的，欢快的跟在叶辰身边，叶辰跟着混沌珠异常的提示，来到了一座山峰上
此峰如鹰嘴朝天，大概有千丈之高，树木环绕，山间盘旋着三尺宽的山道，山腰处有个方圆百里的平台，有几座宏伟的殿堂，前面是巨大的演武场，再往上就是很多的房舍，随着高度房舍建的就越少了，最顶层应该是峰主或者地位比较高的人居住。
叶辰来到了广场上，回头看了一眼小墨，小墨竟不知何时摘了一株灵元草在吃，吃的津津有味，看着叶辰回过头的目光，小墨眼珠子滴溜溜的转了一圈，一边不断的往嘴里塞灵元草，一边扭着屁股撒娇卖萌。
content_en:
Ye Chen killed nearly a thousand monsters along the way, leaving corpses along the way. Ye Chen rushed all the way and reached a mountain peak, where he lost consciousness and fell to the ground.
The Luoxia Mountains were full of battlefields at this time, and a large number of monks poured in. The monsters were frightened, and there were monsters everywhere. Some of them quickly ran to Luoxia County. Fortunately, the governor of Qian County had been alert before and did not panic. However, the four major families all entered the Luoxia Mountains at this time, and the only people guarding the city were the guards of the City Lord's Mansion and the city guards. The city gate has been closed.
Fortunately, the monsters did not plan to attack the city at the beginning. If the vision of heaven and earth had not appeared in time and happened a few days later, the monsters would have definitely attacked the city. Currently, there are only more than 30,000 monsters attacking the city, and the rest are scattered throughout the Luoxia Mountains.
After a day and night of killing, and the disappearance of the vision, the monsters gradually returned to the depths, and corpses of monsters could be seen everywhere outside the mountains.
There were as many as 20,000 monsters killed at the city gate, and the rest had already fled in all directions.
However, at this time, the Luoxia Mountains ushered in a large number of monks. There were more than 100,000 monks in the four major sects, the imperial city, and various large and small families. Most of the monks in the Body Tempering Realm just picked up some monster beast corpses in the periphery to sell them. There were about 70,000 to 80,000 people in the Qi Refining Realm, 30,000 to 40,000 in the Foundation Establishment Realm, and several hundred people in the Golden Core Realm!
As the saying goes, there is always more to it than there is to it.
“铿铿锵锵，乒乒乓乓”到处都是打斗声。
At this time, Ye Chen slowly opened his eyes. I saw a girl in purple clothes, with gleaming eyebrows, piercing eyes, crystal clear eyes, and a delicate face. Looking at myself.
"Are you awake?" the girl asked calmly. The voice is soft and gentle, like the sound of nature, and the air is filled with a faint and elegant fragrance.
"Who are you?" Ye Chen asked softly with a breath of anger.
"I am Qingyun Sect, Gongye Qian'er. I passed by here and vaguely felt that you were still alive, so I saved you." The girl is still ordinary, and the ancient well has no waves, as if it is insignificant.
"Thank you Miss Gongye for saving me. If the girl is in need in the future, Ye Chen will do his best to help her." Ye Chen replied firmly, this is a promise from the Immortal Emperor, and it is hard to get even ten thousand gold! It's just that Gongye Qian'er didn't know that today's rescue had changed her life. The two of them had twists and turns and suffered a lot in the future.
Gongye Qian'er didn't express her position, just glanced at it briefly and ignored it.
Ye Chen looked at the cold and charming Gongye Qian'er and stopped talking. He sat cross-legged and calmed down, quietly and naturally, running the Nine Revolutions Immortal Art. In fact, Ye Chen's body was no longer seriously injured. During his coma, Gongye Qian'er asked Ye Chen for a Jing Yuan Dan, which is a third-grade healing elixir. The Chaos Body itself has the ability to heal itself, and the Chaos Body absorbs the spiritual energy of the world all the time. This injury, coupled with the extreme killing of the body, this healing has completely tempered the body from the inside out. Ye Chen's physique is now comparable to the Foundation Establishment Realm.
Ye Chen practiced with peace of mind for three hours and his body recovered.
"You have recovered, let's say goodbye." Gongye Qian'er looked at Ye Chen calmly, turned around and left.
Ye Chen looked at the girl in purple and secretly remembered it in his heart. He changed his clothes and walked out of the cave.
There are fights everywhere on the first floor, and the lives of people in the world of immortality are like grass. This is a road of no return. A genius who has not grown up is not a genius. It is not Ye Chen's indifference. Along the way, Ye Chen lets go of his consciousness and rushes as fast as possible, no longer caring about these fights.
When he felt the barrier, the concentration of spiritual energy was 10 times that of the outside. The surrounding flowers, plants and trees became more vibrant. A large number of monks rushed into the barrier. Ye Chen no longer hesitated and quickly followed in. This is a ruins that is striking to the eye. Seeing the broken walls and ruins, Ye Chen wasted two days and took away almost everything that could be taken away. Ye Chen carefully observed the surroundings. This was the mountain gate of a sect. A huge plaque with the name "Luoxia Holy Land" on it lay quietly in the ruins.In the ruins, this plaque turned out to be an earthen artifact, weighing a million kilograms. A mountain gate was actually thousands of feet long. The Luoxia Holy Land stretched as far as the eye could see. Bones and new corpses could be seen everywhere. It was probably caused by fighting for treasures.
This scene is like locusts passing through the border. They have traveled thousands of miles without finding anything valuable. Walking further, you will see a square with a radius of thousands of miles and enough to accommodate 100,000 people. It should be a martial arts arena. The ground is covered with bones, and there are many tall and unusual skeletons, as black as ink. It's weird, like it's a foreign race. There are mountains all around the square, rising one after another, with tens of thousands of peaks in total.
Let's continue to go deeper. The surrounding area is probably a place for outer disciples, and the value is definitely not high. At this time, the Chaos Bead started to move. Ye Chen found that Xiao Mo was now one foot big, so he immediately moved Xiao Mo out of the body. After Xiao Mo came out, he was extremely excited, jumping up and down, and happily followed Ye Chen. Ye Chen followed the abnormal prompts from the Chaos Bead and came to a mountain peak.
This peak is like an eagle's beak pointing up to the sky, about a thousand feet high, surrounded by trees, with a three-foot-wide mountain road circling the mountain. There is a platform with a radius of a hundred miles on the mountainside, and there are several magnificent palaces. In front of it is a huge martial arts field, and above it are many houses. As the height increases, there are fewer houses built. The top floor should be occupied by the peak owner or someone with a higher status.
Ye Chen came to the square and looked back at Xiao Mo. Xiao Mo unexpectedly picked a piece of Ling Yuan grass and was eating it at some point. He ate it with gusto. Seeing Ye Chen's gaze back, Xiao Mo's eyes rolled around in a circle. He kept stuffing Ling Yuan grass into his mouth while twisting his butt to act cute.
